summary: Iteration 16 — Validated GET /api/companies/me/qr.png QR endpoint and the QrCodeModal frontend feature. 20/20 backend tests PASS (all 6 kinds, auth, size clamp, pyzbar decode confirms /c/<slug>/... URL). Frontend Branding tab loads cleanly on /admin, MyUrlCard renders all 5 QR triggers (subdomain/path/3 kiosk pills), modal opens with PNG image (480x480) for every trigger, Download/Copy/External-link/Close buttons all present and functional. No useNavigate runtime errors on /admin (the 3 refactor misses are fixed). Sidebar navigation (Overzicht/Appartementen/Branding) works.

integration_issues.issue: navigator.clipboard.writeText fails silently in headless Chromium without clipboard-write permission, so the 'Kopieer' button does not flip to 'OK' during automated test. Code path is correct; verified manually in screenshot. NOT a production bug — real browsers grant the permission. Optional: add a fallback document.execCommand('copy') for robustness.

action_items: (Optional, low-prio) Add document.execCommand('copy') fallback in QrCodeModal.copyUrl so the visual feedback works even when navigator.clipboard is unavailable.
(Optional) Endpoint silently clamps any size<160 up to 160 with no error — current behaviour, just confirm it matches product intent.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py /api/companies/me/qr.png: input validation & server-side URL construction via _QR_KIND_PATHS is solid — phishing-safe.
Endpoint emits Cache-Control: private, max-age=300 + Content-Disposition inline filename — correct.
QrCodeModal correctly revokes the blob URL on unmount/key change preventing memory leak.
MyUrlCard wires 5 distinct testids (my-url-{subdomain,path,kiosk-admin,kiosk-huurder,kiosk-klant}-qr) — good testability.
Endpoint passes Pillow's optimize=True PNG output — image_size 800x800 returns ~6-12KB, well-shaped.
